description: An interface defining options for parsing JSON objects in the org.eclipse.ditto.json package. It includes methods to create new builder instances and to check whether URL decoding should be applied to strings before parsing.

classes.name: JsonParseOptions
classes.description: An interface specifying options for parsing JSON data, including creation of builder objects and URL decoding preferences.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new mutable builder object for constructing JsonParseOptions instances.

methods.name: isApplyUrlDecoding
methods.description: Indicates whether the JSON string to be parsed should undergo URL decoding prior to parsing.
